title: Agent cost: every agent's spend is recorded across turns and shown, instead of $0

chat.text: The agent registry reports $0 for every task mastermind spawned today, so the Sessions page and the models page under-report spend and cost per result cannot be computed. A Sonnet task mastermind finds where the per-turn cost is lost (reset on resume, most likely), makes the registry accumulate it from appended records so a restart recomputes it, shows it on the Sessions rows and the task cards, and backfills today from the SDK session files into a one-screen table by task and model.
